faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Quick answers to common day-to-day questions.

cannotSeeCustomer.question: Why can't I see a client?
cannotSeeCustomer.answer: You can usually only see clients you own or co-own. If a client is in the public pool, deleted, or outside your responsibility, it may not appear in your list.

customerInPublicPool.question: Why did a client enter the public pool?
customerInPublicPool.answer: Common reasons are long periods without valid follow-up (default around {{reclaimDays}} days) or manual release. Keep logging valid follow-ups to reduce reclaim risk.

aiAnalysisIncomplete.question: Why is AI analysis incomplete?
aiAnalysisIncomplete.answer: If first-contact notes or follow-up history is thin, AI may not have enough context yet. Add real follow-up notes and check again.

whyRecordFollowUp.question: Why do I need to log follow-ups?
whyRecordFollowUp.answer: Follow-ups help you and your team track progress, trigger reminders, and improve AI analysis. Without records, it is easy to miss the next contact.

welcomePageFirst.question: Why do I see the welcome page after sign-in?
welcomePageFirst.answer: The welcome page lets you read the latest announcement and reminders before entering the main CRM.

followUpRequired.question: Why can't I submit the follow-up form?
followUpRequired.answer: Make sure next follow-up time and customer intent are filled in, and next action is at least 10 characters.

createConfirmWait.question: Why do I have to wait before confirming a new client?
createConfirmWait.answer: To prevent accidental mistakes, the system requires a {{seconds}}-second wait and review in the confirmation dialog.

cannotClaimPool.question: Why can't I claim a public pool client?
cannotClaimPool.answer: Possible reasons: 7-day claim quota reached (default {{quota}}), still in cooldown (default {{hours}} hours), or you released that client yourself.
